description: This Swift source file implements a command-line utility for discovering gateways on macOS. It includes options parsing, performing asynchronous discovery operations, and outputting results in JSON or human-readable format. The main functionalities involve starting/stopping discovery, handling user options, and printing the discovered gateways.

classes.name: DiscoveryOptions
classes.description: Handles parsing and storing command-line options for gateway discovery.

classes.name: DiscoveryOutput
classes.description: Defines the structure for JSON output of the discovered gateways, including nested Gateway class.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a DiscoveryOptions instance.

methods.name: runDiscover
methods.description: Main function to execute the discovery process asynchronously based on user options.
